messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered (PD #INC-4592) — latency p99 > 1200ms for /v1/generate in eu-west. SLO burn detected (p99 window 5m).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired to eng-oncall [INC-4592] — unacked

sam: acked. i'm on it. grabbing charts.

elaine: i can join — just finishing a deploy but can jump. what's the scope?

sam: trending spike started ~1768888600. qps steady, but tail latency climbs. looks like a small subset of hosts in eu-west with long queue times.

matt: checking node metrics now. cpu/gpu utilization low across pool, but kube-proxy on node eu-west-5 shows high conntrack drops. could be ephemeral network flaps.

sam: reprod query (from metrics):
```
GET /metrics/query?expr=histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",region="eu-west"}[5m]))
```
p99 jumps to ~1.2s.

ops-lead: customer impact? any 502/5xx?

sam: no 5xx spike. responses delayed but successful. looks like increased tail latency only — affecting interactive features (chat & streaming). Might impact big-embeddings batch jobs too but numbers low.

elaine: can we route traffic away from eu-west-5 or kick the node? If it's conntrack leaks we should isolate before it ripples.

matt: attempting graceful drain of eu-west-5 worker pool (scale down + drain). will mark node unschedulable and cordon, then drain.

sam: stepping through runbook -> "p99_tail_latency" -> suggests: 1) isolate hosts with high net drops 2) scale up fallback pool 3) enable regional fallback to eu-central.

incident-bot: Runbook step executed: cordon+drain initiated on node eu-west-5 by matt at 1768888742.

matt: drain started. moving active pods.

elaine: while pods move, can we temporarily relax autoscaler cooldowns to spin new pods faster? Right now it's 300s.

sam: changing HPA minReplicas for inference-eu to +2 to absorb traffic. doing it now.

sam: kubectl patch hpa inference-eu -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'

sam: scaling taking effect, new pods entering ready state.

matt: eu-west-5 node drained and cordoned. connection errors dropping on that node. looks cleaner now.

sam: p99 trending down to ~700ms. still above SLO but improving.

ops-lead: notify support? any customers likely to open tickets?

elaine: i've scanned customer-facing latency alerts — two enterprise customers (acme-corp, dataflow-ai) have upticks in admin dashboards. pinging accounts.

sam: adding a temporary routing rule: route 10% of eu-west traffic to eu-central as buffer.

sam: applied route +10% fallback at 1768888870.

incident-bot: Alert note updated: mitigation actions: cordon eu-west-5, scale HPA, route fallback +10%.

matt: infra note: investigating conntrack table size — we had a kernel upgrade queued on eu-west-5 earlier this week that bumped defaults. suspect leak with sidecar TCP keepalive. filing infra-ticket INF-2102.

elaine: we should add a short-term compensating control: reduce sidecar keepalive frequency for older nodes. will draft a safe change.

sam: p99 now ~420ms, p95 ~120ms. within SLO band but i'll keep monitoring for 10m.

ops-lead: good. set PD to resolved once stable for a bit? what's our decision threshold?

sam: per runbook, keep PD open until p99 < 600ms for 10 consecutive minutes and node issue triaged.

incident-bot: PD note: escalations paused.

matt: recorded node logs (conntrack overflow) and kernel messages to INF-2102. attaching snippet:
```
Nov 12 10:34:21 eu-west-5 kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet.
Nov 12 10:34:22 eu-west-5 kube-proxy: conntrack: failed to save flow
```

elaine: thanks. i'll prepare a PR to adjust keepalive and HPA cooldown defaults, reference INF-2102.

sam: marking incident in slack as 'mitigated' — monitoring. if stable for 10m we'll resolve PD and close thread.

ops-lead: good job team. please add a short post-incident note in incidents/ once PD resolved with root cause hypothesis and next steps.

sam: will follow up. tagging @matt for infra action item and @elaine for runtime config PR.

incident-bot: PD [INC-4592] still open — last update 1768888925.

sam: last note: no customer-facing errors, only latency. continuing to observe.

elaine: i'm around for the debrief.

matt: staying on it, will update INF-2102 with remediation ETA.

sam: closing loop in 8 minutes unless we see regression. :thumbsup:
